visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing an oversized white t-shirt featuring a cat illustration and light-colored baggy trousers, stands in front of the Ximen Station Exit 3 at night. She walks toward the camera with a cheerful expression, holding a red beverage cup from 'TEA BUS'. She presents both hands to the camera, showcasing her fresh pink and silver manicured nails. Pink and white heart animations float around her as she touches her cheeks with her hands in delight. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of hands with long nails struggling to type effectively on a mechanical keyboard. The woman is then seen in a home setting with a professional gaming setup, including dual monitors and a ring light. She looks at her hands with a look of frustration. A red and white circular explosion graphic appears on the screen. (3) A close-up shot depicts a manicured nail being forcibly clipped off with a metal nail clipper. The background is dark with a circular vignette focusing on the finger. The shot concludes with a fade to black.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat and cheerful piano melody accompanied by a light, rhythmic percussion beat. The tonality is major and conveys a sense of celebration and happiness. There is no speech or significant environmental noise. (2) A series of sharp, percussive mechanical keyboard clicks are heard prominently. A sudden transient trigger occurs as a recorded game voice announces 'Spike planted' followed by synthetic gunfire and a broadband explosion sound effect. The upbeat BGM continues at a lower volume underneath these action sound effects. (3) The background music shifts abruptly to a slow, somber piano and string arrangement with high harmonic tension, resembling a funeral march. A sharp, metallic 'snap' sound from a nail clipper occurs as a transient event. The ambiance remains silent behind the melancholic music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously depict the 'painful' realization that long manicured nails interfere with daily life, specifically gaming performance, leading to the ultimate decision to remove them.
